knowledge:
- key_parameters: pipelineDef/pipDef=A PipelineDefinition object defining the consecutive steps, functions, and evaluation metrics ;; alternatives=A named list where each element represents a parameter and contains a vector of alternative values or function names to test ;; datasets=A list of datasets (or paths to RDS files) to run the pipeline on ;; comb=A matrix or data.frame of parameter combinations to run, built using buildCombMatrix and optionally filtered ;; nthreads=Number of threads to use for parallel execution ;; output.prefix=Character string specifying the prefix for saving intermediate and evaluation RDS files ;; skipErrors=Logical; if TRUE, the pipeline continues running even if some parameter combinations or datasets produce errors ;; agg.by=Parameter(s) by which to aggregate results in plotting functions like plotElapsed or evalHeatmap
- alternatives: The documentation mentions specific alternative methods for scRNA-seq steps: norm.seurat, norm.sctransform, and norm.scran for normalization; filt.lenient and filt.stringent for filtering; seurat.pca for dimensional reduction; and clust.seurat for clustering. For DEA steps, it mentions sva.svaseq (SVA) and dea.edgeR (differential expression) compared to none (no correction/filtering).
- when_to_use: Use when benchmarking and comparing different bioinformatics pipelines (e.g., scRNA-seq preprocessing/clustering or bulk RNA-seq DEA) across multiple parameter settings, algorithms, and datasets to identify the most robust and performant workflow.
- pitfalls: Stringent cell filtering in scRNA-seq can introduce strong biases against specific subpopulations, which should be monitored using the max pc.lost metric ;; Standard Pearson correlation between PCs and covariates (like library size) can be biased due to major differences in library sizes between subpopulations; use meanAbsCorr.covariate2 or PC1.covar.adjR2 instead ;; Most clustering evaluation metrics (including ARI) are highly sensitive to the absolute deviation from the true number of clusters; it is recommended to use a combination of MI, ARI, and ARI at the true number of clusters ;; Multithreading can make debugging errors inside runPipeline difficult; use the detailed error reports generated by pipeComp to reproduce errors offline.

workflows.name: bulk_rna_seq_dea_benchmarking
workflows.intent: Benchmark and evaluate bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis pipelines (filtering, SVA, and DEA steps) on datasets with known ground truth.
input: dataset1.rds (SummarizedExperiment object containing a 'counts' assay, a 'condition' colData factor, and rowData with 'expected.beta' and 'isDE' columns)
dataset2.rds (SummarizedExperiment object containing a 'counts' assay, a 'condition' colData factor, and rowData with 'expected.beta' and 'isDE' columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Define evaluation function evaluateDEA ;; 2. Define step functions for filtering, SVA, and DEA ;; 3. Assemble the PipelineDefinition object using PipelineDefinition ;; 4. Add the evaluation function to the DEA step using stepFn ;; 5. Define alternative parameter values and wrapper functions ;; 6. Run the pipeline using runPipeline ;; 7. Plot results using plotElapsed, evalHeatmap, and dea_evalPlot_curve
workflows.code:
evaluateDEA <- function(dea, truth=NULL, th=c(0.01,0.05,0.1)){
  dea <- pipeComp:::.homogenizeDEA(dea)
  if(is.null(truth)) truth <- metadata(dea)$truth
  dea <- cbind(dea, truth[row.names(dea),])
  dea <- dea[!is.na(dea$expected.beta),]
  res <- c(logFC.pearson=cor(dea$logFC, dea$expected.beta, use = "pairwise"), logFC.spearman=cor(dea$logFC, dea$expected.beta, use = "pairwise", method="spearman"), logFC.mad=median(abs(dea$logFC-dea$expected.beta),na.rm=TRUE), ntested=sum(!is.na(dea$PValue) & !is.na(dea$FDR)))
  names(th) <- th
  res2 <- t(vapply( th, FUN.VALUE=vector(mode="numeric", length=6), FUN=function(x){
    called=sum(dea$FDR<x,na.rm=TRUE)
    P <- sum(dea$isDE)
    TP <- sum(dea$FDR<x & dea$isDE, na.rm=TRUE)
    c( TP=TP, FP=called-TP, TPR=TP/P, PPV=TP/called, FDR=1-TP/called, FPR=(P-TP)/sum(!dea$isDE) )
  }))
  res2 <- cbind(threshold=as.numeric(row.names(res2)), as.data.frame(res2))
  row.names(res2) <- NULL
  list(logFC=res, significance=res2)
}
step.filtering <- function(x, filt, minCount=10){
  get(filt)(x, minCount=minCount)
}
step.sva <- function(x, sva.method, k=1){
  mm <- stats::model.matrix(~condition, data=as.data.frame(colData(x)))
  get(sva.method)(x, k=k, mm=mm)
}
step.dea <- function(x, dea.method){
  x2 <- DataFrame(get(dea.method)(x,mm))
  metadata(x2)$truth <- metadata(x)$truth
  x2
}
pip <- PipelineDefinition( list( filtering=step.filtering, sva=step.sva, dea=step.dea ) )
stepFn(pip, step="dea", type="evaluation") <- evaluateDEA
def.filter <- function(x, minCounts=10){
  library(edgeR)
  minCounts <- as.numeric(minCounts)
  x[filterByExpr(assay(x), model.matrix(~x$condition), min.count=minCounts),]
}
sva.svaseq <- function(x, k, mm){
  k <- as.integer(k)
  if(k==0) return(x)
  library(sva)
  sv <- svaseq(assay(x), mod=mm, n.sv=k)
  if(sv$n.sv==0) return(x)
  colnames(sv$sv) <- paste0("SV", seq_len(ncol(sv$sv)))
  colData(x) <- cbind(colData(x), sv$sv)
  x
}
dea.edgeR <- function(x, mm){
  library(edgeR)
  dds <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(assay(x)))
  dds <- estimateDisp(dds, mm)
  fit <- glmFit(dds, mm)
  as.data.frame(topTags(glmLRT(fit, "condition"), Inf))
}
none <- function(x, ...) x
alternatives <- list(
  filt=c("none","def.filter"),
  minCount=10,
  sva.method=c("none","sva.svaseq"),
  k=1:2,
  dea.method="dea.edgeR"
)
res <- runPipeline( datasets, alternatives, pipelineDef=pip, nthreads=4 )
plotElapsed(res, agg.by="sva.method")
evalHeatmap( res, what=c("TPR","FDR","logFC.pearson"), agg.by=c("sva.method", "dea.method"), row_split = "sva.method" )
evalHeatmap( res, what=c("TPR","FDR"), agg.by=c("sva.method", "dea.method"), row_split="sva.method", filterExpr=threshold==0.05 )
library(ggplot2)
dea_evalPlot_curve(res, agg.by=c("sva.method","dea.method"), colourBy="sva.method", shapeBy="dea.method")
dea_evalPlot_curve(res, agg.by=c("sva.method")) + ggtitle("SVA methods, averaging across DEA methods")
evalHeatmap(res, what=c("TPR","FDR"), agg.by=c("sva.method","k"), show_column_names=TRUE, anno_legend = FALSE, row_split="sva.method", filterExpr=threshold==0.05 )

workflows.name: scrna_seq_clustering_benchmarking
workflows.intent: Benchmark and evaluate single-cell RNA-seq clustering pipelines (doublet detection, filtering, normalization, feature selection, dimensional reduction, and clustering steps).
input: dataset1.SCE.rds (SingleCellExperiment object with true subpopulations stored in the `phenoid` colData column)
dataset2.SCE.rds (SingleCellExperiment object with true subpopulations stored in the `phenoid` colData column)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the scRNA-seq pipeline definition using scrna_pipeline ;; 2. Load alternative wrapper functions ;; 3. Define alternative parameter values ;; 4. Run the pipeline using runPipeline ;; 5. Evaluate and plot filtering bias using scrna_evalPlot_filtering ;; 6. Evaluate and plot reduced space metrics using scrna_evalPlot_silh and evalHeatmap ;; 7. Evaluate and plot clustering accuracy using evalHeatmap and scrna_evalPlot_overall ;; 8. Plot computing times using plotElapsed
workflows.code:
library(pipeComp)
pipDef <- scrna_pipeline(pipeClass = "seurat")
source(system.file("extdata", "scrna_alternatives.R", package="pipeComp"))
alternatives <- list(
  doubletmethod=c("none"),
  filt=c("filt.lenient", "filt.stringent"),
  norm=c("norm.seurat", "norm.sctransform", "norm.scran"),
  sel=c("sel.vst"),
  selnb=2000,
  dr=c("seurat.pca"),
  clustmethod=c("clust.seurat"),
  dims=c(10, 15, 20, 30),
  resolution=c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1, 1.2, 2)
)
res <- runPipeline( datasets, alternatives, pipDef, nthreads=3)
scrna_evalPlot_filtering(res)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
scrna_evalPlot_silh( res )
h <- scrna_evalPlot_silh( res, heatmap_legend_param=list(direction="horizontal") )
draw(h, heatmap_legend_side="bottom", annotation_legend_side = "bottom", merge_legend=TRUE)
evalHeatmap(res, step="dimreduction", what="log10_total_features", what2="meanAbsCorr.covariate2")
evalHeatmap(res, step="dimreduction", what="log10_total_features", what2="meanAbsCorr.covariate2") + evalHeatmap(res, step="dimreduction", what="log10_total_counts", what2="meanAbsCorr.covariate2")
evalHeatmap( res, step="dimreduction", what2="meanAbsCorr.covariate2", what=c("log10_total_features","log10_total_counts"), row_title="mean(abs(correlation))\nwith covariate" )
evalHeatmap(res, step="clustering", what=c("MI","ARI"), agg.by=c("filt","norm"))
evalHeatmap(res, step = "clustering", what=c("MI","ARI"), agg.by=c("norm", "dims"), row_split=norm)
evalHeatmap(res, step = "clustering", what=c("MI","ARI"), agg.by=c("filt","norm")) + evalHeatmap(res, step = "clustering", what="ARI", agg.by=c("filt", "norm"), filter=n_clus==true.nbClusts, title="ARI at\ntrue k")
h <- scrna_evalPlot_overall(res)
draw(h, heatmap_legend_side="bottom")
plotElapsed(res, agg.by="norm")
